title: Floating Lips in Teacups
description: Surreal arrangement of translucent teacups stacked and floating in a dreamy composition. Each cup contains a pair of closed female lips, surrounded by flowing blue and white vaporous ribbons, golden sparkles, and scattered white petals against a soft white ethereal background.
